## Barrier Description
Describe the interaction barrier encountered (e.g. keyboard trap, missing accessible name, color contrast failure, screen reader announcement gap, small touch target).

## Affected Component or Screen
- **View / Screen**: [e.g. Header mobile navigation, Plant Recommendation, Garden Doctor, Space Modal]
- **Element Description**: [e.g. Category filter pill, Dialog close button, Form input]

## Assistive Technology or Mode Used
- **Screen Reader**: [e.g. NVDA, VoiceOver, TalkBack, JAWS, None]
- **Input Method**: [e.g. Keyboard only, Touch, Switch Control]
- **Device Viewport**: [e.g. 375px mobile, 768px tablet, 1280px desktop]

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Navigate to '...' using [Tab / Touch / Screen Reader]
2. Observe behavior: '...'

## Expected Accessible Behavior
What should happen according to WCAG 2.1 AA or inclusive design best practices.

## Suggested Remediation (Optional)
If known, suggest semantic HTML elements, ARIA attributes (`aria-pressed`, `aria-label`), or CSS touch target adjustments.
